# Forklia

> Forklia is a remote digital product studio founded by Fabian Pernía (Full Stack Engineer) and Fabio Pernía (Creative Director & Head of Sales). It designs and codes mobile apps, websites, SEO/GEO strategies and interactive brand systems for clients in any country, in English and Spanish. Spanish version: https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/es/

## Modules (services)

- [Mobile apps](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/services/#apps): native iOS and cross-platform apps, from discovery to App Store and Google Play.
- [Web development](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/services/#web): landing pages, company sites, e-commerce and custom platforms.
- [SEO & GEO](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/services/#seo): technical SEO, content, structured data and optimization for AI answer engines.
- [Brand systems](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/services/#branding): logo, palette, type and interactive brand kits with an email signature generator.

## Deploys (projects)

- [Lyapp](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/work/lyapp/): iOS app to track a baby's sleep, feeding and health in their first year. Live on the App Store.
- [Simply Andy](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/work/simply-andy/): identity, bilingual portfolio and interactive brand kit for a UGC creator.
- [Your English Buddy](https://fablexis.github.io/web-agency/work/your-english-buddy/): website for an academy teaching practical English to Spanish speakers.
